source_text: Diversitas munerum diversitatem meritorum et charismatum in ecclesia designat. Gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Diversity of-gifts diversity of-merits and of-charisms in church designates. Glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: The diversity of offerings marks diversity of merits and gifts in the church. Glory forever. Amen.
